After words of direction ending in अञ्च् there is लुक् elision of the affix अस्ताति।

Terms: अस्ताति

In the छन्दस् , the case-endings other than the सर्वनामस्थान , get the acute accent when coming after अञ्चि।

Terms: accent-विभक्ति-समास

The affixes क्त्वा , क्त and क्त्वातु get the इट् augment after the root अञ्च् when meaning 'to honour or do something to show honour'.

Terms: इट् augment

The निष्ठा त is changed to न after अञ्च् but not when it is in connection with an Ablative -5th case.

Terms: निष्ठा changes
